dialogues.speaker: Thianges
dialogues.text: A—Anxious?! Me?! H—Haha, dream on! I'm just a little... seasick, yeah! I'm just a little dizzy! I just want to get back to the city — my city — and find a place to rest!

dialogues.speaker: Thianges
dialogues.text: After all, who doesn't want to settle down after a long journey, am I right? Especially for... people who want to live a peaceful life. Like me!
